definitions: A structure carrying a road, path, railway, etc. across a river, ravine, or other obstacle.
The elevated, enclosed platform on a ship from which the captain and officers direct the ship.
A removable dental prosthesis that replaces one or more missing teeth.
The part of the nose that is between the eyes.
A card game played with two pairs of partners.
examples: The captain was on the bridge.
She had a new bridge fitted.
He has a high bridge to his nose.
They played a game of bridge.
